title: Command Logger
description: Command Logger is a lightweight server-side Minecraft Forge mod that provides real-time command logging with a focus on transparency, fairness, and accountability.
body:
# Command Logger
Command Logger is a lightweight server-side mod for Minecraft Forge that records and displays commands executed by players and the server console in real time. No client installation is required.

Designed with transparency and accountability in mind, the mod allows players to verify which commands are publicly logged while giving server administrators flexible tools to manage hidden commands when necessary. This helps build trust between staff and the community by making command logging policies visible rather than relying solely on administrator discretion.

### Features
- Real-time command logging for players and the server console.
- Server-side only — players do not need to install the mod.
- Personal and global hidden command lists.
- Command group management for easier configuration.
- Stealth Mode for moderators and operators.
- Public visibility of globally hidden commands via /cmdlog globalhiddenlist to improve transparency and fairness.
- Separate permissions for Players, Moderators, and Operators.
## Commands

### Available to everyone
```
/cmdlog help — Shows all commands available to you based on your permission level.
/cmdlog cmds list — View all commands you have personally hidden.
/cmdlog cmds hide <command> — Hide a command from your chat.
/cmdlog cmds show <command> — Unhide a command so it appears in your chat again.
/cmdlog group available — View all available command groups and their contents.
/cmdlog group list — View the groups you currently have hidden.
/cmdlog group hide <group> — Hide an entire group at once. For example, mob hides both /summon and /kill.
/cmdlog group show <group> — Unhide an entire group.
/cmdlog console hide <command> — Hide a specific console command from appearing in your chat.
/cmdlog console show <command> — Unhide it.
/cmdlog globalhiddenlist — View commands hidden globally by Moderators or Operators.
```

### Moderator / Operator
```
/cmdlog global hide <command> — Hide a command from all players.
/cmdlog global show <command> — Remove a command from the global hidden list.
/cmdlog global list — View all globally hidden commands.
/cmdlog global group hide <group> — Hide an entire group from all players.
/cmdlog global group show <group> — Unhide an entire group globally.
/cmdlog global group list — View all globally hidden groups.
/cmdlog global group available — View all available groups.
/cmdlog stealth on — Hide your commands from regular players.
/cmdlog stealth off — Disable stealth mode.
```

### Operator (requires OP level 1 or higher)
```
/cmdlog console player — Console commands are visible to all players. (default)
/cmdlog console mod — Console commands are visible to Moderators and OPs only.
/cmdlog console off — Console commands are visible to OPs only.
/cmdlog stealth-op on — Hide your commands from both players and Moderators.
/cmdlog stealth-op off — Disable OP stealth mode.
/cmdlog mod add <player> — Grant a player Moderator permissions.
/cmdlog mod remove <player> — Revoke a player's Moderator permissions.
/cmdlog mod list — View all current Moderators.
```
